2026-11-26.title: Arrietty
2026-11-26.overview: 14-year-old Arrietty and the rest of the Clock family live in peaceful anonymity as they make their own home from items "borrowed" from the house's human inhabitants. However, life changes for the Clocks when a human boy discovers Arrietty.

2026-11-26.title: Pom Poko
2026-11-26.overview: The Raccoons of the Tama Hills are being forced from their homes by the rapid development of houses and shopping malls. The Raccoons practice and perfect the ancient art of transformation until they are even able to appear as humans in hilarious circumstances.

2026-11-26.title: The Tale of The Princess Kaguya
2026-11-26.overview: Found inside a shining stalk of bamboo by an old bamboo cutter and his wife, a tiny girl grows rapidly into an exquisite young lady. The mysterious young princess enthrals all who encounter her. But, ultimately, she must confront her fate.

2026-11-26.title: Porco Rosso
2026-11-26.overview: In Italy in the 1930s, sky pirates in biplanes terrorize wealthy cruise ships as they sail the Adriatic Sea. As he prepares to battle the pirate crew's American ace, Porco Rosso enlists the help of spunky girl mechanic Fio Piccolo and his longtime friend Madame Gina.

2026-11-26.title: Whisper of the Heart
2026-11-26.overview: Shizuku lives a simple life, dominated by her love for stories and writing. One day she notices that all the library books she has have been previously checked out by the same person: "Seiji Amasawa."

2026-11-26.title: Treasure Hunting
2026-11-26.overview: The film is an adaptation of a picture book by Rieko Nakagawa and Yuriko Yamawaki, with illustrations by Yuriko Omura. 2026-11-26.title: Ghiblies: Episode 2

2026-11-26.title: Imaginary Flying Machines
